recap: Goal: Teaching simulation: prioritize contacts when call capacity is limited; the prediction is made before the first contact of the campaign, from the client file.

Decided: prediction moment; feature availability (excluded campaign, day, duration, month; kept despite a doubt: contact); split (stratified random, 30% for validation); success criterion (precision gain over the baseline of at least 5 points); preprocessing (the default: no missing-value indicator, every category kept, no cap, no transform); variant (stronger regularisation); policy threshold:0.2 (the logistic model on the 1086 validation rows: precision 38.1%, recall 29.6%, result 93100838).
Now: Open the final test once; the report and notebook are up to date.
Next: whether you adopt the policy: "Call the 100 clients with the highest scores."
